title: The Lost Notebook
summary: Recover the lost notebook while dealing with the Hive's traps.
overview: Recover the lost notebook while dealing with the Hive's traps.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Follow the mission's enemy and recovery objectives through the Hive.
When a trap engages, prepare for a group of additional drachnids.
Move as a group and recover before triggering another trapped area.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 4.
